professionalService.problemSolved: Let a developer, architect or buyer compare six distinct townhouse plots in one street composition, identify the available plot 04 and inspect its entrance and key rooms.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: The same numbered row changes from drawing to materialized street while plot 04 stays identified; the route enters its show house and ends in the atrium facing its garden.
professionalService.decisionValue: Clarifies repeated-versus-varied facade relation and the spatial experience behind one selected plot. Donor sold/reserved/available states, bedroom count, area and reservation CTA are authored, not verified Rubik facts.

evidence.statement: Six status-labeled houses and outlined plot 04 at A0.
Plot 04 atrium at B.
Pinned take defines six houses, statuses and only plot 04 interior.

continuityInvariants.statement: All six plot positions and their repeated/alternate roof, window and door patterns persist through ink, relief and material front.
